-- ATV for whole company, periods 1-3 FY2026/27, including web orders
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_sales AS (
    -- Store sales: use sale_date, exclude staff purchases
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS store_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS store_receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- physical stores only
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- exclude staff purchases
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'                  -- exclude test articles
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_sales AS (
    -- Web sales: use dispatch date from fact_web_order
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS web_orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled')
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'                  -- exclude test articles
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- exclude staff purchases if any
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((store_sales.store_net_sales + web_sales.web_net_sales) / 
           (store_sales.store_receipts + web_sales.web_orders), 2) AS atv
FROM store_sales, web_sales;

-- Verify: breakdown of store sales vs web sales
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        'Stores' AS channel,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
        ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        'Web' AS channel,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
        ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status <> 'cancelled')
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT * FROM store_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM web_sales;
